__doc__: Where OpenClaw's tools read a LOCAL FILE they then send on, read statically (no run, no model) from the published packages: openclaw 2026.7.1 (dist/*.js, a local install) and openclaw 2026.9.9 (npm pack, dist/*.mjs), 2026-10-17. Pins the `upload` table of arbiter/policy/tool-gate-surface.ts (OPENCLAW_GATE_SURFACE) and the proxy's upload-gate.ts openclawUploadRefs. Excerpts are the source text, trimmed; both builds read the same keys.

message.snakeCase: resolveSnakeCaseParamKey(params, key): the key as written, else its snake_case spelling (file_path, media_url, file_url, media_urls)

excerpts.schema: media: Type.Optional(Type.String({ description: "Media URL/path. data: use buffer." })), filename: Type.Optional(Type.String()), buffer: Type.Optional(Type.String({ description: "Base64 attachment payload; data URL ok." })), … attachments: Type.Optional(Type.Array(Type.Object({ type: …, media: Type.Optional(Type.String()), name: …, mimeType: … }), { description: "Structured attachments; each entry uses media." }))
excerpts.collect: function collectActionMediaSourceHints(args, extraParamKeys, options) { for (const key of buildActionMediaSourceParamKeys(extraParamKeys)) { … sources.push(entry.value) } for (const value of readStringArrayParam(args, "mediaUrls") ?? []) … if (options?.structuredAttachments === "all") sources.push(...collectStructuredAttachmentSources(args).map((source) => source.value)) …
excerpts.loader: loadWebMediaInternal(mediaUrl): stripLegacyMediaDirectivePrefix (MEDIA:), media:// → the inbound media store, file:// → safeFileURLToPath, http(s) → readRemoteMediaBuffer (fetched), ~ → resolveUserPath, relative → path.resolve(workspaceDir, mediaUrl), then readLocalFileSafely
excerpts.dataUrl: normalizeSandboxMediaParams: assertMediaNotDataUrl(entry.value) (a data: URL in a source param is refused; inline bytes go in `buffer`)
excerpts.actions: send, broadcast, sendAttachment, upload-file, setGroupIcon, emoji-upload, sticker-upload, set-profile, … all pass hydrateAttachmentParamsForAction over the same params

message.destination: the channel: delivered from OpenClaw's process (executeSendAction) or through a gateway (runGatewayPluginMessageActionOrNull; `gatewayUrl` names any endpoint) to a channel API whose root is configurable (Telegram DEFAULT_TELEGRAM_API_ROOT "https://api.telegram.org", overridable) or a plugin's own transport. No host the proxy can vouch for.

excerpts.refs: const pathInputs = normalizeMediaReferenceList([...typeof record.path === "string" ? [record.path] : [], ...filterStringEntries(record.paths)]); … const imageRaw = trimmed.startsWith("@") ? trimmed.slice(1).trim() : trimmed;
excerpts.native: if (modelHasVision) imageRoute = { kind: "native" } … if (imageRoute.kind === "native") { const result = await buildNativeImageToolResult(loadedImages, options?.config) … } (content blocks {type: "image", data: base64}: the tool_result carries the image to the session's own model)
excerpts.fallback: imageRoute = { kind: "fallback", imageModelConfig, … } … return buildTextToolResult(await runImagePrompt({ … imageModelConfig: imageRoute.imageModelConfig, prompt: promptRaw, images: loadedImages.map(…) })) (the bytes go to an image model resolved from agents.defaults.imageModel, the primary provider's vision model, or the auto media providers)

view_image.destination: a model: the session's own (native route) or an image model OpenClaw picks (fallback route). The proxy cannot tell which route a call takes.

excerpts.route: createImageTool: execute … return buildTextToolResult(await runImagePrompt({ … })) (always an image model call; no native route in 2026.7.1)

excerpts.upload: case "upload": { const paths = Array.isArray(params.paths) ? params.paths.map((p) => String(p)) : []; … const resolvedResult = await resolveExistingUploadPaths({ requestedPaths: paths }); … browserArmFileChooser(baseUrl, { paths: normalizedPaths, … })
excerpts.root: resolveExistingUploadPaths: each path within DEFAULT_UPLOAD_DIR (<OpenClaw tmp dir>/uploads) or the inbound media dir; a relative one is read under that root

browser.destination: the page whose file chooser receives the files
